channel.title: GodotAwesome
channel.description: Your place for Godot Engine content: tutorials, projects, and community insights for indie developers and open-source creators.

item.title: Godot Shader Tutorial for Beginners: 5 Simple 2D Effects (Godot 4)
item.description: Godot shader tutorial for beginners: 5 copy-paste 2D canvas_item shaders (grayscale, hit flash, gradient, ring, dissolve) with GDScript for Godot 4.

item.title: Which tiles does a Rect2i hitbox cover in Godot 4?
item.description: Find the grid cells under a Godot 4 Rect2i hitbox. Run an integer-coordinate probe and check a crate on a tile edge, across the origin and at zero width.

item.title: GDScript vs C# in Godot 4: Which One Should You Pick in 2026?
item.description: GDScript or C# for Godot 4? Platform support, speed, setup and the same script in both languages, so you can decide in five minutes. Checked against the official docs.

item.title: Import AI 3D Models into Godot 4: Meshy, Blender, Poly Haven

item.title: Godot Web Export (HTML5): Quick Guide for Godot 4

item.title: Godot AI Code Policy 2026: What It Means for Contributors and Game Developers

item.title: Interrupted scene-edit tools in Godot: inspect before retrying
